name: anim_dobe_dive
subject: a huge muscular Doberman monster made of glossy pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks
desc: Showing off a perfect dive: the goo monster crouches, swings both arms back, then springs up out of its puddle and stretches into a straight, elegant head-first diving line with arms extended together, its gooey lower body peeling off the floor into a trailing tail.
